note: Saskatchewan regional park (Brightsand Lake Regional Park Authority) at the north end of Brightsand Lake, about 27 km NE of St. Walburg. Non-electric sites 21-23 and 32, beside the boat launch, sit on open ground at the shore; the electric sites called beachfront (13-19) are across the main beach road in the trees. 52 of its 125 sites are seasonal. 9-hole golf course, concession, two rental cabins and registered ATV trails. --Claude
summary: Keep (local, 58% nightly: 73 of 125 sites for reservation). Site classes and 2026 rates read (C$30 non-electric to C$50 full service, + GST/PST; entry C$10/day; C$10 reservation fee). 2027 season May 15 - Sep 15; online booking opens Apr 1, 2027. WATERFRONT LEAD: stored 'not waterfront' -> 'lakefront' supportable on nightly non-electric sites 21, 22, 23, 32 (open ground ~30-40 m from the shore by the boat launch, ~53.6454,-108.8557); electric 'beachfront' 13-19 are a view at best (road + trees). Pin OK. Google 4.4 (105).
flags: WATERFRONT (upgrade lead, reviewer decides): stored 'not waterfront' (Claude-era, no evidence text). Let's Camp describes site 21 'beachfront', 22 'open concept, beach front', 23 'open concept site beside boat launch; waterfront', 32 'waterfront site' - all Premier non-electric, sold nightly on Let's Camp (C$30), max RV 36-38 ft. Their photos show the lake across open grass a few tens of metres away (32 straight ahead with tables at the shore; 21 and 22 just past a few spruces; 23 a glimpse). Esri z17: the open lot by the boat launch (~53.6454,-108.8557; launch ~53.6449,-108.8556) is shore side of the beach road, ~30-40 m of open grass/sand to the water. Supports 'lakefront' with a caveat naming 21-23 and 32 (no electric). The electric sites marketed 'Beachfront - along main roadway' (13-18A, 30 A) and 19 ('across from main beach') sit on the inland side of the main beach road under trees, with the day-use main beach between; their photos show only forest. If the reviewer won't rest the value on non-electric sites, keep 'not waterfront' (the electric rows are a view at best).

LONG-STAY (local): SRP site table gives 73 of 125 sites for reservation and 52 seasonal (~58% nightly). Several Let's Camp descriptions say sites are 'bordered by seasonal campsites not shown on map' (36, 49, 50, 52-54, 70). No discouraging wording. Google Maps 4.4 (105 reviews), shared with the golf course and beach.

OHV: the park lists 'ATV Trails' and charges an ATV registration (new/renewal); Let's Camp amenities include ATV trails. A lake regional park with golf and beach, not an OHV staging camp - general campground with an ATV side; flag only.
HOOKUPS: sewer rests on one site (Site 1 / Let's Camp 100, C$50); the 30 A water sites are 201-212.

FEES: stored 35-50 from brightsandlake.org 2026-10-15; low now 30 (Premier/Regular non-electric sites that take 36-38 ft rigs). The SRP page's fee table is older (15 A $30, 30 A $35) - the park's own 2026 rates page used.
